vault/ is a faithful mirror and therefore carries the non-conformant corpus: `bin/kad-wiki lint` reports 140 errors over 139 distinct paths (138 MISSING_KAD_ID, one TRAINING_GATE, one INELIGIBLE_AUTHORITY), of which 14 are live-captured session pages the substrate keeps adding. The corpus was untracked at the WP-057 cutoff and is committed as of 534685d, so this is now a repository-resident content decision rather than untracked drift; by construction the count cannot fall while capture continues.

the OMP orchestration preflight reports BLOCKED: UNAPPROVED_OR_PAYG_MODEL_SURFACE, MEMORY_NOT_OFF, AUTOLEARN_ENABLED and LOCAL_PROCESS_OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN:zai-free. The receipt is deterministic and correct, but no entrypoint runs it — not the Makefile, Justfile, package.json or any workflow — so its verdict reaches no caller.

The fixture is now isolated and the live-posture coupling lives in exactly one named test.

DECLARED 2026-09-11: the harness posture is stated in .omp/RULES.md (approvalMode=yolo, memory.backend=mnemopi, autolearn.enabled=true) and `node tools/kad/posture-check.mjs`, wired into `make verify`, fails when the declaration and .omp/config.yml disagree. The yolo posture itself was widened in 1a738b5 with no recorded decision; it is now a declared operator decision rather than an unrecorded one.

`make test` delegates to `npm test`, which covers the kad, workspace, librarian, gaya, state-artifact and ask_user suites (876 tests, 0 failing on 2026-09-11). Previously the enrolled gate ran 15 of 84 kad test files, so it was green while the root gate was red.

the wiki of record was repaired on 2026-09-11: a truncated object write had left refs/heads/master pointing at a zero-byte object, so `git log` failed while the ISA validator reported PASS on ref-presence alone. History was re-anchored on 9023f9d1, the index rebuilt, and memory.record.versioned now resolves HEAD.

the Gaya frame evidence for WP-GAYA-DATASET-G1-01..08 was promoted from the kad-rpg staging tree into the evidence_target paths the ledger declares.
